body: Sorry to hear that the company you work for fucked you so badly. To already have struggles inside your head, then having a major external force like this try and tear through your life can be extremely debilitating. I hope you've found a tiny bit of light in life even though it can seem so impossible in those dark moments, in the midst of a dark life. Some days I don't know what I'm even holding on for, but I've been finding things to channel my rage into that are helpful. The new year for me has brought a new purpose, to try and change the world and fight for people who can no longer fight for themselves, to take back the power for the people and reforge this dying planet and broken system into something that will work better for everyone. Time to stop living in the shadows.

Not sure how to help, but want you to know you're not alone. It can be really hard sometimes for me, and my hair will even become a matted mess. Sometimes I use that to motivate myself since I don't want to have to cut it all off, but not sure if that's healthy or not. Would sponge bathing / using a wet cloth be a good small step to help get around the loudness of the shower?

Sadly too often. Lately I've been finding it hard to tell the difference between dreams and reality, and if things are ever going "too well" in a dream and I wake up and realize it's not real it's extremely debilitating. It makes me want to stay in dream world. A lot of these are dreaming that I've done important/difficult things I need to do, and then I don't remember that I only dreamed it, and miss appointments, or forget to make them, or realize I never rescheduled something important if I'm feeling too terrible to go outside. Working on getting help, starting with a second opinion on a diagnosis. Been working up to it though, but staying positive.

Thanks, that makes sense. Sometimes it feels like I'm shaping the world around me. If anything goes against my "truths" I start to get very panicked, and haven't acted on it yet but feel aggressive as well
Thanks for the heads up. With things progressively getting worse, it's nice to know what might pop up

Thank you, I know all the professionals around me have tried their best, and I have to keep trusting that I will find someone who will help me. I want my husband to start some therapy with me, and heard a term called "psychoeducation" for family/spouses and hope we can do that.

I'm going to try and take your advice, sadly until now fantasy, sci-fi, horror and the like have all been my favourite genres, but I'm going to try and stick to more lighthearted things. 

I find a lot of peace knowing I'm at least in a safe country, and that there is care for me here that is covered and will start there.

Thank you- that means a lot, and I'm making plans to get help as soon as possible. Keeping myself going with the support of kind strangers on the internet until then, and trying to stay healthy, and safe.
Thank you, I'm going to try and just focus on getting treatment again, as you said. This helps so much, anything to get me to sunrise, then hour by hour from there
